keep.text: Pehle main 3 litre se 4 litre paani peeta tha, uske baad bhi mujhe pyaas lag jaati thi, aur phir baar baar baar main washroom jaata tha,
phir bhi mujhe pyaas lag jaati thi.
Pata hai kyun?
Kyunki main paani pee hi nahi raha tha sahi tareeke se.
Aap ye jaan lijiye, main sirf aur sirf chemical pee raha tha,
aur jiska naam hai H2O.
Do hydrogen aur ek oxygen, bas.
Har insaan hamesha paani aise hi peeta hai, usko lagta hai.
Par kaun sa paani peena hai?
Stream ka peena hai, nadiyon ka peena hai,
pattharon se guzra hua paani peena hai. Tabhi toh minerals wo paani absorb karta hai, aur wo minerals jismein calcium hota hai, magnesium hota hai,
sodium hota hai, potassium hota hai, sab ka sab us paani ke saath aata hai, tab wo paani
paani banta hai H2O se.
Phir dheere dheere dheere pollution aaya.
Pollution aaya toh filter aaya, filter aaya toh RO aaya.
RO ne gandagi ekdam nikaal di,
aur
ye sahi kiya,
main aapko bata raha hoon.
Par
saath saath mein saare ke saare minerals maar diye.
India ki sthiti ekdam kharab ho chuki hai paani ke maamle mein. Aap log jaake dekh lena, main aise research papers bhi le karke aap logon ko dikhaunga isi channel pe. Toh
is channel ko zaroor follow kar lena.
Ab samjho ki intracellular aur extracellular
paani kya kya hote hain?
Intracellular matlab ki cells ke andar ka paani.
Aur ye aapke organs chalate hain,
jaise brain chalta hai, reactions chalte hain,
ye saari cheezein intracellular
karata hai.
Extracellular matlab ki cells ke bahar ka paani.
Ye sirf guzar raha hai,
munh se andar gaya aur bladder se bahar nikal gaya,
kuch nahi kiya.
Cell ke andar jaata hi nahi hai. Isi liye piya hua paani aap log jab jaate ho washroom toh nikaal aate ho,
aur body dehydrated ki dehydrated rehti hai.
Aur ye dehydration brain ka bhi hota hai.
Sirf 2% dehydration
aapki cognitive skills girane lagti hai.
Memory slow ho jaati hai, mood disturb ho jaata hai,
focus ekdam toot jaata hai,
aur decision making aapki bhi
weak ho jaati hai.
Sochiye, aap office mein baithe ho, 3 litre paani bhi pee rahe ho,
phir bhi focus nahi ban raha hai, jo ki aaj ke time pe logon ke saath ho raha hai.
Ye ekdam pandemic type ka ho chuka hai.
Meeting mein aapko yaad nahi reh raha hai ki kya bolna hai, kya nahi bolna hai, aur shaam tak ekdam irritated feel kar rahe ho.
Gym mein aap logon ko sprain aa raha hai, aapko lag raha hai ki 4 se 5 litre paani pee rahe hain, phir bhi kaise meri muscles khinch jaa rahi hain. Mere saath hua ye saari cheezein.
Aur ye saari cheezon ka fix
ek simple sa khaari namak hai.
Sea salt.
Paani mein thoda sa sea salt daal dijiye,
aap logon ko saare minerals milna shuru ho jaayenge.
Aur ye chhote chhote hacks maine apne poore ke poore health protocol mein
daal diye hain.
Toh
agar aap logon ko bhi health protocol ke baare mein kuch bhi jaanna hai,
toh comment box mein likhiye HP, aap logon ke paas link
pahunch jaayega.
